data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for music playback with notification handling and desktop system controls.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for playing music from assets, local files, or network streams. It handles lock-screen controls, notifications on Android, Now Playing / Control Center on iOS and macOS, SMTC on Windows, and MPRIS on Linux.
use_when: You need cross-platform audio playback supporting mobile, desktop, and web.
You require background audio playback with system media controls and lock-screen integration.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-channel audio mixing or low-latency sound effects.
You need fully custom notification layouts generated by your Dart code.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Integrates with system media controls and notifications out-of-the-box.
Simple singleton interface for quick setup.
weaknesses: Relies on a singleton instance, which may limit architectural flexibility.
Custom notification layout configuration is not exposed by the public API.
Desktop platforms require specific native development dependencies (like GStreamer on Linux).
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration: background audio modes and ATS settings in Info.plist for iOS, cleartext traffic and SDK version configurations for Android, entitlements on macOS, and GStreamer development packages on Linux.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature-rich, highly customizable audio player with support for playlist management, clipping, and gapless playback.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler and widely used audio playback plugin for playing multiple simultaneous audio sources easily.
